headline: Monday at the lake: cool start, warming into the 80s, mostly sunny
lede: Monday, September 28 brings a cool start to the week with overnight lows near 62°F, climbing to a pleasant high in the mid-80s under mostly sunny skies with very low rain chance. Perfect conditions for a relaxed day on Table Rock Lake, exploring the Strip, or catching a matinee show.
